Collapsed the species subclasses into a generic `Animal` model and moved species differences into the registry/data layer.

- Added [`ActorKind.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/ActorKind.java) as the explicit logical identity for animals, grass, and hunters.
- Made [`Animal.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/Animal.java) concrete and registry-driven.
- Updated [`SpeciesRegistry.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/SpeciesRegistry.java) to create generic `Animal` instances directly.
- Converted prey configuration in [`SpeciesConfig.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/SpeciesConfig.java) from Java classes to `ActorKind`.
- Updated [`FieldStats.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/FieldStats.java) and [`SimulatorView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/SimulatorView.java) to key counts/colors off `ActorKind` instead of concrete subclasses.
- Updated [`Hunter.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/Hunter.java) and [`Grass.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/Grass.java) to expose their `ActorKind`.
